shortMessage: The body is digesting the last meal; blood glucose and insulin levels rise.

shortMessage: Excess glucose is stored as glycogen in the liver and muscles.

shortMessage: The stomach empties; insulin levels gradually decline.

shortMessage: The digestive system calms down; insulin approaches baseline.

shortMessage: Insulin returns to baseline; liver begins tapping glycogen stores.
